name: LSnodeGeom
description: Extends ScGeom for faster LevelSet-based simulations of convex bodies while storing previous closest node in surfNodeIdx<LSnodeGeom.surfNodeIdx>, for an optimal contact detection.

attributes.name: surfNodeIdx
attributes.description: Index (within surfNodes of id2 if Volume(id1) > Volume(id2); else id1) of the surface node that shows the smallest interparticle distance (overlap or not). A negative value that would be encountered during an actual simulation would mean an inconsistency in implementation.

attributes.name: usedWorkflow
attributes.description: Tells for debugging purpose whether this interaction has just (in last Ig2 call) been handled by looping over full nodes because geom was just created (0) or because surfNodeIdx was directly detected as negative (1); or by looping just the neighbor subset (2, desired case), which could itself deteriorate into an additional full loop (3).

attributes.name: penetrationDepth
attributes.description: Penetration distance of spheres (positive if overlapping)

attributes.name: shearInc
attributes.description: Shear displacement increment in the last step

attributes.name: normal
attributes.description: Unit vector oriented along the interaction, from particle #1, towards particle #2. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: contactPoint
attributes.description: some reference point for the interaction (usually in the middle). |ycomp|

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: incidentVel
methods.description: Return incident velocity of the interaction (see also Ig2_Sphere_Sphere_ScGeom.avoidGranularRatcheting for explanation of the ratcheting argument).

methods.name: relAngVel
methods.description: Return relative angular velocity of the interaction.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
